title: RTI-based reporting on Force One partners and separate historical business role
retrievalMethod: Exa full-page fetch; authored notes only; page's local publication time 3 Dec 2023 rather than metadata's 2 Dec UTC.
locator: RTI paragraph naming Force One partners; Multibuild paragraph; final response paragraph.
notes: Reporter says an RTI response from BMC identified Sanjay Mashilkar as owning Force One Multi Services with sons Pritam and Pranjal as partners.

Report describes Mashilkar as a party secretary in Shinde-led Shiv Sena on the publication date, previously associated with the Uddhav-led faction, switching in June 2022. Party role is contextual and does not locate a 2020 payment.
Report names Mashilkar and dismissed assistant police inspector Sachin Vaze as business partners in Multibuild Infraprojects Private Limited.
Mashilkar acknowledged a business partnership with a police officer, said there was nothing wrong with it and said the company stopped operations within months because it won no contracts.
No transfer between Force One, Multibuild or Vaze is identified by this source. Company CIN, shareholding, appointment dates and original RTI annexures were not obtained.
Other allegations in the article are outside this trail and not imported.
limitations: Secondary account of RTI documents, not the RTI originals. 'Partner' is reporter terminology for a private limited company, not proof of share percentage or formal director title. No current role or financial tie inferred.
